title: 2003 AMC 10A Problem 1
statement: What is the difference between the sum of the first \(2003\) even counting numbers and the sum of the first \(2003\) odd counting numbers?

solutions.text:
The \(k\)th even number \(2k\) is exactly \(1\) more than the \(k\)th odd number \(2k-1.\)

Summing this difference over all \(2003\) pairs gives \(2003 \cdot 1 = 2003.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Pair each even number with the odd number just below it
Each of the \(2003\) pairs contributes a difference of \(1\)
